title: Horizon Guest Lecture 2027
objectives: Showcase student talent to the wider campus

claims.claim_text: We anticipate around 127 attendees, a significant increase over earlier turnout, driven by stronger promotion.
We can deliver this Guest Lecture efficiently within INR 12,000, well below typical costs.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
